$comment: The release-candidate tag the compat CREDENTIAL lanes run against (ADR-0056). null = no RC cut yet: the credential crons refuse rather than test main. Cutting an RC is a founder action: push the vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag, then bump rcTag here in a reviewed PR. scripts/compat-credential-ref.mjs resolves it.
$rcBumpMarkerComment: #1302 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/compat-credential-freeze-guard.yml refuses any PR touching a file the credential harness executes (derived, see docs/ci/credential-freeze-guard.md), unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: rcBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...', paths?: ['exact/frozen/path', ...] }. #1635: a marker exempts only the PR that introduces it (absent at that PR's merge base, or a new date/reason); a marker inherited from main exempts nothing, and #2325: neither does one that arrived with a branch merged into the PR, and a pin-only PR that just removes or shortens the marker passes without one. #1641: a PR changing rcTag fails unless that tag already exists on the remote and is reachable from main.

rcBumpMarker.reason: Founder approval 2026-11-05 through the selector: 'Approve (jev 0.88): build R5 now and land it after review, loses at most a run or two of v1.0 streak', for getknext-dev/knext#2041 (v2 R5): every credential workflow's scheduled credential runs join one concurrency group with queue: max (the two early-warning crons stay out), and the slot watchdog flags a cancelled, timed-out or never-started credential run and a group over capacity. The founder then held the merge until the next v1.3 rc runs green. Effect, stated exactly: the executing test-e2e-deploy.yml and scripts/compat-window-audit.mjs (comments only) are fingerprinted inputs of all four v1.0 cells, so merging this RESTARTS their current streaks; the longest-streak records are unaffected. compat-credential-v1.3.yml changes bytes too (the concurrency block by a new declared derivation substitution, its header's generated text, and the scripts/compat-line-workflow.mjs and scripts/compat-window-audit.mjs guard-script sha256 lines), so all four v1.3 cells' windows restart as well. compat-vinext.yml changes, but its cell is not wired and banks no window. rcTag is unchanged (v1.0.0-rc.6); no compat dispatch was run.

$publishedBytesBumpMarkerComment: #1663 — while rcTag is non-null, .github/workflows/published-bytes-freeze-guard.yml packs the publishable group at a PR's own merge ref and diffs it against the pinned rc tag's already-packed tarballs, unless this object is ALSO present and unexpired: publishedBytesBumpMarker: { date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', expires: 'YYYY-MM-DD', reason: '...' }. Same #1635 introduced-by-this-PR rule as rcBumpMarker. Remove once the pinned rcTag itself moves to the new rc (PR B, #1660).

publishedBytesBumpMarker.reason: Lead decision 2026-10-10 under the founder's 'don't block on me' direction, applying the same rule the founder-approved scoped markers established for X1 (#2076) and V1 (#2078). v2 X3 platform-layer P0, CLI half (#2096): minScale/maxScale are emitted only when set, which changes @getknext/core bytes on main. Main has carried the 1.3 line since X1. Credential runs pack from the v1.0.0-rc.6 tag checkout, not from main, so no v1.0 credential fingerprint moves.
